Research artwork supplied by the teacher, 2026-10-16.

These four PNG files are byte-for-byte copies of the supplied transparent sheets.
The UI uses clipped SVG viewports to display individual pictures; no generated
replacements, raster edits, added labels, or changes to the original artwork.

metallurgy.png
Source: codex-clipboard-c958b24b-ade6-4da8-a891-7b31714d4e22.png
Left to right: Bronze equipment, Iron equipment, Steel equipment.
Copper equipment reuses the existing shield icon in research-images/shield.svg.

archery-logistics.png
Source: codex-clipboard-edc3430d-56d6-402c-83e1-9199bdb6e9eb.png
Left to right: Simple bows, Recurved bows, Longbows, Organized marches,
Road networks. The three marching figures are one illustration.
A sloping display boundary keeps the third spear separate from the road workers.

production.png
Source: codex-clipboard-6a0add53-7014-4186-9b78-578360feec79.png
Left to right: Crop rotation, Irrigation, Sawmilling, Mining tools.

All displayed names, benefits, prerequisites and prices come from the existing
RegimentDevelopment catalog. Original images are 2172 x 724 pixels with alpha.

facilities-horsemanship.png
Source: codex-clipboard-347c9409-f753-4227-96b2-7919478895ac.png
Top row, left to right: Hospital (Medicine), Academy (Education), Civic Hall
(Sanitation), Manufacturing. Bottom row: Saddles, Stirrups.
The manufacturing picture also identifies the existing Workshop facility.
Granary reuses research-images/storage.svg. Riding and Siege engineering reuse
cavalry and artillery artwork. Construction, Masonry, Urban planning and
Architecture reuse the corresponding settlement and fortification pictures.
The source sheet remains unchanged; all separation happens in display viewports.
Only territory.facilities entries create building icons on the map.
